Monk

1 person
Beds

Bathroom

A tiny cell for one, like a monk's: white cement walls, no window, and air conditioning shared with the room next door through a vent. It is pitch dark inside and no sound from outside comes in. Our guests keep telling us it gave them the best sleep of their whole holiday.
